mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 1% signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods where RSAFS falls > 1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the industrial production index above 0.5% signals stronger manufacturing output, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where INDPRO rises > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls above 100,000 signals stronger labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where PAYEMS rises > 100,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 0.25% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) above 5% signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction-related earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods where HOUST falls > 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points combined with a monthly decline in nonfarm payrolls above 100,000 signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp AND PAYEMS falls > 100,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp AND PAYEMS falls > 100,000 (t-test p > 0.05).
